name: Shell
verdict: Shell's Nigerian subsidiary admitted liability for the 2008 Bodo oil spills in the Niger Delta.
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): Shell plc (listed; largest holder BlackRock 8.1%, no state) - Shell's then Nigerian subsidiary SPDC admitted liability in the English High Court for two 2008 oil spills at Bodo in the Niger Delta and paid £55 million in 2015.

why.text: In 2008 two oil spills from a pipeline run by Shell's Nigerian subsidiary SPDC polluted the Bodo area of the Niger Delta. In 2015 SPDC agreed to pay £55 million to 15,600 people and the Bodo community, having admitted liability for the spills in the English High Court.
why.messageLine: Shell's Nigerian subsidiary admitted liability in an English court for two 2008 oil spills at Bodo in the Niger Delta and agreed to pay the community £55 million.
